title: Make the Overdue status badge red and accessible
task: The 'Overdue' badge in the orders table is yellow and support keeps missing it in screenshots. Make it red, and make sure screen readers announce the status.
plan:
1. In web/src/components/StatusBadge.tsx change COLORS.overdue to { bg: "#fee2e2", fg: "#991b1b" }.
2. Add role="status" and aria-label={`Order status: ${LABELS[status]}`} to the <span>.
3. No API or data changes. Run `npm run lint`; there are no component tests for StatusBadge today, so verify visually in the orders table.

nice_to_have: role="status" is a live region and is semantically wrong for a static badge rendered per table row; aria-label on a span with visible text, or plain visible text, is enough
red/red contrast of the chosen colours should be checked (#991b1b on #fee2e2 is fine)
should_not: Invent risks (data, security, performance) for a colour and aria change
Ask the user to decide colour codes or request approval ceremony
fixture_facts: web/src/components/StatusBadge.tsx exists with COLORS and LABELS maps and renders a plain <span>
There are no tests for web components in tests/
